description: A LOOKUP whose source is the documents of a class (ADR-0046), in a formula that may read them: a triggered variable, a default, a guard, a rule. The columns are the system columns and the scalar variables of the class; a bare name is one of them, THIS.name a variable of the document the formula belongs to, and ID() and STATE() that document's own. The history of a class is not a source yet.
accept: LOOKUP(Approval, COUNT(id), purchase = ID() AND state = "granted")
LOOKUP(Approval, COUNT(id), state = "granted" AND purchase = ID())
LOOKUP(Approval, SUM(fee), purchase = THIS.code AND urgent)
LOOKUP(Approval, id, state = STATE() AND id <> ID())
LOOKUP(Approval, COUNT(id), created_at < NOW() AND state_entered_at >= updated_at)
lookup(approval, count(ID), Purchase = id() and STATE = "granted")

reject.reason: the version of the class is not a column
the history of a class is not a source yet
the document's own id is ID(); THIS names its variables
the document's own state is STATE()
a bare name is a column of the class; the document's code is THIS.code
only scalar variables are reachable through THIS yet
a query function does not nest inside another's arguments
